title: Ada and the Portrait
author: Casper Zhou
blurb: Beatrix Villalobos, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
